Even with

properties.name: B2B Optimizer
properties.description:
Even with the explosion of commercial sales & marketing systems and data, companies still struggle to identify ideal accounts and contacts, and also struggle to keep their data clean, mostly due to the need for manual housekeeping which is a costly use of staff time.

For the last 20 years, we have been offshoring data collection and data cleanup work. Through trial-and-error, we have developed deep relationships with offshore vendors that we know and trust to provide the highest quality work at offshore prices.

While very appealing, most companies find that working with offshore services is difficult with differences in language, time zones and communication.

B2B Optimizer exists to bridge the gap. We provide data acquisition, management and housekeeping so that our customers can get the best of both worlds working with us: a US-based company at offshore prices.

We also help companies build and execute their B2B marketing plans by developing the:
• Market/customer research, analysis, messaging, personas, buyer journey
• Marketing approach, strategy and results modeling
• Go-to-market plans and execution
• Setting up and running Account-Based Marketing, Demand Generation and Lead Generation
• Specifications and buildout of the sales and marketing technology stacks

Even with the explosion of commercial sales & marketing systems and data, companies still struggle to identify ideal accounts and contacts, and also struggle to keep their data clean, mostly due to the need for manual housekeeping which is a costly use of staff time.

B2B Optimizer exists to bridge the gap. We provide data acquisition, management and housekeeping so that our customers can get the best of both worlds working with us: a US-based company at offshore prices.

We also help companies build and execute their B2B marketing plans by developing the:
• Market/customer research, analysis, messaging, personas, buyer journey
• Marketing approach, strategy and results modeling
• Go-to-market plans and execution
• Setting up and running Account-Based Marketing, Demand Generation and Lead Generation
• Specifications and buildout of the sales and marketing technology stacks

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

TECHNICAL INFO FOR IT DEPARTMENTS:
Mavrick is an enterprise-class system, architected and built from the ground up — infrastructure to product.
Architecture — A purpose-built runtime with a single secure API ingress, a job queue, persistent state, and an autonomous worker layer (Python, Modal, Vercel, Supabase).
Cost governance — One reasoning gateway with model tiering and prompt caching, behind a hard spend-cap governor, so AI costs stay predictable and capped.
Safety & control — Human approval ("cleared hot") before the agent spends or sends anything, idempotency so it never double-acts, and CAN-SPAM compliance enforced in code.
Integrations — Connects natively to 3,200+ tools across sales, marketing, analytics, and productivity, inside Slack.
Production-grade — Live in production, Slack-native, SOC 2 underway.

B2B2C Marketing

Marketing and operations automation helps by providing a consistent platform for all stakeholders to refer to as a guide for marketing and sales activities. When the system is set up, the marketing operation can define overall brand guide-lines.
iClarity B2B2C Marketing Automation Platform can take over some of the traditional tasks of the intermediary, with services such as programmed responses, drip marketing and social media monitoring.
One database, controlled by the product provider and accessed selectively by everyone involved, provides a huge depth of benefits.
Marketing automation frees everyone, including intermediaries, from routine tasks and allows them to focus on other core activities that are becoming continually more critical as the marketing environment continues to evolve.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of

If you're evaluating a Marketo migration, a HubSpot alternative, or looking for a MAP as serious about MOps as you are — we're worth a close look.

Marketing automation the way it should work. Finally.

B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep

Rules:

    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.

  - When in doubt, label false.
